stress_input.schema: Results_Querey/Stresses.csv elements 1-30 and Axial.csv elements 37-63; load case 1 is followed vertically by load case 2
stress_input.processing: Only the first fixed-size result block in each file is read, so appended duplicate blocks are ignored.

volume_averaging.column_panel_volume: panel_thickness * panel_width * panel_length for each adjacent panel

mass.skin_area_mm2: panel_thickness * panel_width, evaluated separately for panels 1-10
mass.note: Geometry-derived Mass_computed logic; FE extracted volumes are not used for mass.

column_buckling.combined_section: half effective width from each adjacent panel, retaining each panel's own thickness in centroid and inertia calculations
